# Notched bar ssna303 in plane strain (example ex2 of mfem-mgis-examples:
# finite strain plasticity, logarithmic strain of Hencky, linear isotropic
# hardening, MUMPS), with its behaviour generated by the generic-parallel
# interface. The executable is the one of mfem-mgis-examples, run in its
# build directory, the behaviour library being given by its option -l; the
# mode of integration is given by the environment variables of mfem-mgis.
set(MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX2_DIR "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_BINARY_DIR}/ex2"
  CACHE PATH "build directory of the example ex2 of mfem-mgis-examples")
add_generic_parallel_mfront_libraries(ex2-behaviours CUDA
  "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_SOURCE_DIR}/ex2/IsotropicLinearHardeningPlasticity.mfront")

# short tests: the first two time steps of the loading (restricted test
# mode of the example), during which the plastic flow starts, on two
# processes, the resultant force on the upper boundary being compared to the
# reference values of the example, without and with the FBar formulation,
# point by point (generic library of the example), all the computations by
# kernels with the generic library and by batches with each backend. All
# the tests write the resultant forces and the ParaView files in the build
# directory of the example. One OpenMP thread per process, MUMPS
# oversubscribing the cores otherwise.
proto_check_executable(_usable "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX2_DIR}/ssna303")
if(_usable)
  set(_run mpirun -n 2 ./ssna303 --nbsteps 2 --end-time 0.05
           --reference-file ssna303-force.ref)
  set(_run_fbar mpirun -n 2 ./ssna303 --nbsteps 2 --end-time 0.05
                --use-fbar --reference-file ssna303-force-fbar.ref
                --standard-reference-file ssna303-force.ref)
  set(_kernels "MFEM_MGIS_GRADIENTS_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_INNER_FORCES_COMPUTATION=Kernels;MFEM_MGIS_TANGENT_OPERATOR_COMPUTATION=Kernels")
  set(_tests)
  foreach(_variant "" "-fbar")
    if(_variant STREQUAL "-fbar")
      set(_command ${_run_fbar})
    else()
      set(_command ${_run})
    endif()
    add_test(NAME ex2${_variant}-point-by-point COMMAND ${_command}
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX2_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(ex2${_variant}-point-by-point PROPERTIES
      ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1")
    add_test(NAME ex2${_variant}-kernels COMMAND ${_command}
      WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX2_DIR}")
    set_tests_properties(ex2${_variant}-kernels PROPERTIES
      ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
    list(APPEND _tests ex2${_variant}-point-by-point ex2${_variant}-kernels)
    foreach(_backend ${ex2-behaviours_BACKENDS})
      set(_library "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generic-parallel-${_backend}/src/libGenericParallelBehaviour-${_backend}.so")
      set(_name ex2${_variant}-batch-${_backend})
      set(_device)
      if(_backend STREQUAL "cuda")
        set(_device --device cuda)
      endif()
      add_test(NAME ${_name}
        COMMAND ${_command} ${_device} -l "${_library}"
        WORKING_DIRECTORY "${MFEM_MGIS_EXAMPLES_EX2_DIR}")
      set_tests_properties(${_name} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT "OMP_NUM_THREADS=1;MFEM_MGIS_BEHAVIOUR_INTEGRATION=Batch;${_kernels}")
      list(APPEND _tests ${_name})
    endforeach()
  endforeach()
  set_tests_properties(${_tests} PROPERTIES RESOURCE_LOCK ex2-outputs)
  # the GPU tests hold both locks
  foreach(_name ex2-batch-cuda ex2-fbar-batch-cuda)
    if(TEST ${_name})
      set_tests_properties(${_name} PROPERTIES
        RESOURCE_LOCK "gpu;ex2-outputs")
    endif()
  endforeach()
endif()
